title: Machine learning defines Parkinson's disease states and progression pathways
summary: The approach identified eight disease states (state 8 held 18 of 19 dementia cases) and showed progression pathways differing by starting state, replicated in an independent PDBP cohort of 610 patients. Data come from observational registries.
ai_technology: Contrastive latent variable model with a personalized input-output hidden Markov model

evidence.unknown: Observational registries; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Contrastive latent variable model plus personalised input-output HMM defines Parkinson's disease states

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
